articles.summary: CANTON, Mass., Sept. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Destination XL Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: DXLG), the leading integrated-commerce specialty retailer of Big + Tall men’s clothing and footwear, today announced the appointment of James E. “Jimmy” Olsson as Executive Vice President, Chief Growth Officer.
articles.title: Destination XL Group, Inc. Appoints Jimmy Olsson Chief Growth Officer
